notes: mw-e39.20: Jasper Quell (bible 5.13), Vane's shipping agent. Nervous denials in the hub; the invoice (stand-in fact evidence.foundry-invoice) or the honest manifest (evidence.honest-manifest) unlocks the collapse branch, which can hand over crate access and the manifest and bargain a head start on the mountain road (The Crate for Mr. S: Leverage). Once quell.left is set he is gone: entry gone plays a narrator note only, so no reachable line references him as present (AC-6). Scene presence is gated on quell.left by the future Wendmouth scene.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The agent's office is shut up, the ledger gone and the desk cleared. A note is pinned to the door: 'Gone to see my mother. Mountain road. Do not follow. Do not mention the stone. J. Q.'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Under it, in another hand, someone has written 'Ha.' The door is locked; the ink on the note is a day old.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Oh. A knight. Jasper Quell, shipping agent, Vane Deepworks. I am, ah, entirely at your service. Stone. It is stone. Heavy stone. Is something wrong? You look at me very sternly.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Jasper Quell, shipping, Vane Deepworks. An archer! Good. I have crates, and crates need guarding, and I have a budget. Not a large budget. Are you looking for work?

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Quell, Jasper. Shipping. Sorcerer? Oh dear. You can tell, can't you, if something is cursed? One hears. No reason. Entirely hypothetical. I have a... a hypothetical crate.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Quell. Jasper Quell. Vane Deepworks. Please don't look at my desk. Not that there is anything on it. It is a very ordinary desk. Is there a problem?

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Jasper Quell, Vane Deepworks, harbour agent. Stone. It is stone, all of it, heavy stone. Stone with... look, is there a problem? Is it the factors?

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Oh. You. Again. Stone. Still stone, if that is why you came.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Have you decided? I have been sitting here deciding for you, and I keep arriving at the mountain road.

options.text: May I see the bay nine manifest?
Who are you afraid of, Mr. Quell?
I have the foundry invoice. Forty brass trinkets, goblin style.
I know about your second, honest manifest.
Look at me, Mr. Quell. Plainly.
Yes, I can tell if something is cursed.
Nice desk. Locked drawer, I see.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Yes. Good day. It was only stone. You may tell anyone who asks.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Stone. It is stone. All of it. Heavy stone. Dressed blocks, sealed and stamped. The stamp is perfectly in order. Entirely routine. Why would I say otherwise?

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: The manifest? The manifest is, ah, at the customs house. In copy. The original has been, mislaid. Entirely innocent. Stone does not need so many papers.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Nobody! The factors, perhaps. A little. They are owed money, you see, and they know where I sit. And the inspector, a little. And hanging. I do not like hanging.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Oh, no. No, no, no. All right: the brass came from a foundry on Quay Row. Forty trinkets, goblin-fashioned, on Mr. Vane's instruction. That is all. I said nothing. I said nothing at all.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Four silver a night, and no questions about the weight. It is not a trick. The crates are only very heavy. Think about it; there is no hurry. There is a bit of hurry.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Can you? Splendid. I do not know of anything cursed, naturally. Though if there were a crate that hummed, a little, at night... one might wonder. Hypothetically.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: It is only a drawer. A very dull drawer, full of dull things. Please do not. It is Mr. Vane's, I mean it is mine. It is both. Do not open it.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Where did you find... No. No, no. That is, ah, I may have made some arrangements. On instruction. I have a second ledger. I am a careful man, and careful men keep copies.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: The crate. The manifest. They are all in the bay, and in my desk. I will give you the lot. All I ask is a head start on the mountain road, before Mr. Vane hears. Please.

options.text: Take your head start. Hand it all over.
Hand it over now. No head start.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Thank you. Bay nine's key, the manifest, the drawer. All yours. I will take the mountain road before the tide. If anyone asks, I was never here. Good luck.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: All right! Here, the key, the manifest, take them. Just do not tell Mr. Vane it was me. Or Cray. Or the factors. I will, ah, be at my desk.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: No. I... no. Not without a head start. I will sit here until the tide goes out, and then I will sit here some more. A head start, and everything is yours.

nodes.speaker: quell
nodes.text: Of course. Of course. I will be here. Thinking. Perhaps sweating. Do hurry.
